title: Stop Paying $10 A Month For AI Code Completions
description:
OpenCode is a free, open-source coding agent (208K GitHub stars, 16M monthly developers) - bring your own model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, or an account you already pay for) or use its included free models. No forced subscription. GitHub Copilot's paid Individual plan costs $10/month for the same job. #Shorts #ai #aitools
